# Else If Statement

An `else if` statement checks another condition when the first `if` condition is not true. Use `else if` when your app needs to choose from several possible options.
name: Else If Statement
tips:
- Use `else if` after an `if` statement.
- Put the condition inside parentheses `( )`.
- The `else if` condition is only checked if the earlier `if` condition is false.
- You can use more than one `else if` when checking several options.
- In Web Lab, `else if` is often used for steps, sizes, scores, or other app choices.
